set_background.effect: Configure the next OS-prepared update frame; no drawing or current-color change. SDK/display permission only; strict integral RGB5650..65535.

display.arc_direction: clockwise, zero faces right; end>=start; equal endpoints empty; 0..360 full ring
display.text: UTF8 <=80 bytes; reject invalid/NUL; unsupported scalar -> question mark; transparent shared bitmap; x/y top-left box; align within max_width; clip overflow without wrapping
display.asset: palette-rle-u8-count-index; index0 transparent; integer scale1..4; tint only for tintable assets; mirrored source before scaling
display.asset_id_lookup: canonical id only; metadata aliases are search hints, never runtime identifiers
display.gradient_interpolation: separate RGB565 channels: floor((from*(span-at)+to*at+floor(span/2))/span); span=dimension-1; endpoints included; dimension1 uses color1

frame_preparation.configuration: set_background stores per-VM preference for NEXT update; legal in init/on_button/update; no drawing or dirty change
frame_preparation.accounting: set_background and every logical clear cost1 I/O call and1 logical I/O byte; unchanged wall/instruction/memory/text/grid limits
frame_preparation.prepare: OS performs one complete SDK canvas prefill immediately before update, latches actual applied color, then privately acknowledges pristine ownership
frame_preparation.clear_elision: Only the FIRST clear may skip pixel writes when an active prepared SDK frame is still pristine, full canvas/clip is supported and color equals actual applied prefill; preserve current drawing color and all I/O charges
frame_preparation.later_clear: Any clear consumes eligibility. After painting, repeated clear or different color retains real immediate erase semantics inside the configured callback wall guard
frame_preparation.non_paint: measure_text, set_background, queries, buttons, RGB and jobs never establish or invalidate pristine pixels
frame_preparation.lifetime: End eligibility after update/error/ownership transfer; reset preference to0 on begin/stop/new app and SDK-to-legacy transition; apps cannot acknowledge a prefill
frame_preparation.ui_theme: ui.set_theme configures chosen theme.bg; call it in init for first UI frame or on_button before the next frame. Mutating theme.bg alone does not configure OS; use set_background(custom) explicitly
frame_preparation.legacy: fire-lua-0.1/0.2 remain unchanged, including black preparation, clear semantics and hardware hash
frame_preparation.guards: No rendering queue, deferred app drawing, timer credit/exclusion or new framebuffer. Actual SDK update drawing remains inside the explicit24ms callback wall guard. Legacy updates and all on_button callbacks retain12ms; app init retains250ms. All other resource ceilings remain unchanged.

budgets.text_and_measure_charge: UTF8 bytes to I/O and cumulative text budgets

registry.environment: same restricted Lua5.4 app-private environment, no Python callbacks/require/load/filesystem/OS/M5 handles
registry.render_lifecycle: SDK OS prepares one configured offscreen background before update and presents only the finished frame; display.frame_preparation defines explicit state and clear reuse. Same existing canvas, no extra framebuffer. Legacy behavior unchanged.
